translation: Body pain in summer belongs to dampness, so the acrid-warm Qiang and Fang should be avoided; one should use Mufangji and Cansha.

The injury by the summerheat-heat pathogen is first in the qi aspect; when many days pass without resolution, it gradually enters the blood aspect. If, on the contrary, one thirsts but does not drink much, the lips and tongue are crimson-red, and Qin, Lian, Gao, and Zhi are ineffective, one must use blood medicines, and it suffices to add a single herb that clears qi-heat in appropriate measure.
If mild, use Qinghao, Danpi, Xijiao, Zhuyexin, Yuanshen, Xianshengdi, Xishengdi, Mutong, and Danzhuye; if heat is prolonged with focal distension and binding, select from Xiexin Tang.
